name: serialdash
description: SerialDash monorepo: PWA serial monitor/dashboard, protocol, Arduino library, docs

scripts.gen:check: npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- app/src/protocol/generated docs/protocol/messages.md
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w app --if-present || echo 'app scaffold arrives in M1 (see SPEC.md §11)'
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e -w app --if-present || echo 'e2e arrives in M2 (see SPEC.md §11)'
scripts.docs:screenshots: npm run docs:screenshots -w docs --if-present || echo 'docs:screenshots arrives in M7 (see SPEC.md §11)'
